domainCriteria: Match invocation and access decisions to the actual Java release, caller, module and loader.

Validate mandatory setup through the actual startup entry point and observation of readiness rather than storage syntax alone.

findings.evidence: The previous reference offered static initialization as an alternative to explicit startup resolution. JLS 17 12.4.1 defines active-use initialization. On Temurin 25.0.3, a fixture adapting the accessor sketch obtained a class literal, loaded with initialization=false and enumerated members, then printed READY before the holder initialized and failed with NoSuchMethodException wrapped in ExceptionInInitializerError on its first request.
findings.consequence: A mandatory accessor can remain unvalidated until traffic arrives even though the service declares readiness.
findings.correction: Require actual bootstrap resolution or explicit authorized holder initialization before readiness; identify ensureInitialized as Java 15+, distinguish passive metadata access, avoid side-effectful business calls for setup validation, preserve optional-plugin lifecycles, and add a missing-member bootstrap acceptance control.
findings.technicalControl: Both missing-member launches exit 1, but only the explicit initialization path prevents READY. Supported-member runs pass in both modes with their distinct initialization ordering.

findings.evidence: Java 17 MethodHandles.privateLookupIn and LambdaMetafactory contracts plus named-module execution: same-module lookup modes=31/fullPrivilege=true linked a direct handle; cross-module modes=15/fullPrivilege=false invoked its authorized private target but LambdaMetafactory rejected the caller. A narrow typed adapter worked in both cases.
findings.consequence: The existing distinction prevents incorrectly widening opens or treating an invocable private handle as sufficient metafactory authority. No content change was warranted.

limitations: Compilation targets Java 17 APIs and language but execution was only on Temurin 25.0.3+9; an actual Java 17 VM was not used.

The initialization fixture adapts the existing partial accessor sketch with String standing in for the domain return type and a controlled missing-member name. It proves the tested setup ordering, not all application startup paths.

No performance benchmark, native-image build, ServiceLoader integration, class-loader unloading experiment, or independent agent behavioral evaluation was run. Existing unchanged guidance in those areas was reviewed rather than empirically revalidated here.
Sources are official pages retained at review time; publication pages may evolve. Their exact downloaded hashes are recorded.
Local readiness is not repository-wide verification or a measured improvement in agent behavior.
